ground_truth.unit: standardized coefficient (standard deviations of the 1919 socialist vote share per standard deviation of casualties)
ground_truth.location: Table I, column (1), Share of foot soldier casualties
ground_truth.context: Table I ("The Impact of Foot Soldier Casualties in World War I on the Socialist Vote Share in 1919"), column (1), the first stage. OLS across Italian municipalities of the socialist vote share in the 1919 election on the share of foot soldier casualties (the count of World War I foot soldier casualties from the municipality divided by the total male population over the age of six in 1911), with regiment fixed effects (dummies for any deaths from the municipality in a given regiment), province fixed effects and demographic controls (a quartic in log population and the share of the population below the age of six in 1911).  Standardized coefficients; standard errors clustered at the district (circondario) level.

i4r.notes: Rows matching Table I col 1 (o_coeff 0.119, o_std_err 0.018): row 6195, add-controls variant, r = 0.116 (0.017); row 6162, municipality fixed-effects panel variant, r = 0.095 (0.022).

ground_truth.location: Table I, column (6), Share of foot soldier casualties
ground_truth.context: Table I, column (6): the first stage with the full control set — column (1)'s regiment and province fixed effects and demographic controls plus geographic controls (log area, elevation of the main center, maximum elevation), the socialist vote share in 1913, military controls (veterans from the classes 1874-95 and 1896-1900, casualties among special assault troops and volunteers as a share of the male population above six in 1911, a dummy for army-supplying production plants, a dummy for any casualties in the highest-mortality battles), agricultural controls (share of day laborers, share of sharecroppers, a dummy for local agrarian associations) and urban controls (industry workers and industrial firms over male population in 1911, literacy rate in 1911, share of entrepreneurs and rentiers, share of the bourgeoisie). Standardized coefficients; district-clustered standard errors.

i4r.notes: Table I col 6 (published 0.0979, SE 0.0138; col 5 is 0.0976, SE 0.0136, so the database's 0.098 rows do not separate cols 5 and 6): row 6202, add-controls variant, r = 0.097 (0.014); rows 6159 / 6161 (o_std_err 0.013), municipality fixed-effects variants, r = 0.054 (0.025) / 0.057 (0.024).

ground_truth.context: The F-statistic for the excluded instrument (share of foot soldier casualties) reported at the bottom of Table I, column (6): the test of the casualty coefficient in the full-controls first stage, with district-clustered standard errors.

ground_truth.unit: standardized coefficient (SDs of fascist violence per SD of the 1919 socialist vote share)
ground_truth.location: Table II, Panel A (2SLS), column (6), Socialist vote share in 1919

Standardized coefficients; standard errors clustered at the district level.

i4r.notes: Table II Panel A col 6 (o_coeff 0.500, o_std_err 0.204): row 6154, add-controls variant, r = 0.506 (0.206); row 6213, railroad-distance instrument, r = 0.706 (0.630).  (The database labels five Panel A change-instrument rows, o_coeff 0.379-0.533, "table 1".)

Standardized coefficients; district-clustered standard errors.

i4r.notes: Table II Panel C col 6 (o_coeff 0.498, o_std_err 0.203): row 6192, add-controls variant, r = 0.477 (0.204); row 6158, railroad-distance instrument, r = 0.795 (0.782).

ground_truth.location: Table III, Panel A (2SLS), column (6), Socialist vote share in 1919
ground_truth.context: Table III, Panel A, column (6).  2SLS of the fascist vote share in the 1921 election (fascist lists plus the fascist candidates' share of the National Bloc lists, imputed from district, province or electoral-district candidate data where municipality data are missing) on the socialist vote share in 1919, instrumented by the share of foot soldier casualties, full control set as in Table I column (6).  The 1921 sample is smaller than the 1919/1924 sample. Standardized coefficients; district-clustered standard errors.

cell.label: claude-code
cell.notes: Translated Tables1-7.do (Tables I-III) to fixest. Variables standardized as egen std() over all non-missing rows of fascism_db.dta. Regiment (d_reg*) and province (province*) dummies entered as explicit regressors as in Stata reg/ivreg2 (collinear dummies dropped by feols); ivreg2's partial() does not change point estimates. SEs clustered by circondario1921. First-stage F for column 6 = (b/se)^2 from the clustered OLS first stage with Stata-style small-sample adjustment (the `test` after `reg, cl()`). attempt-1 was an exploratory variable inspection; attempt-2 crashed because circondario1921 is a string and was coerced to numeric NA; fixed by keeping it as character. No claim-feedback iterations were used.
